settings: studies.campaign.run evaluate --target <alliance> --seeds <the 24 held-out seeds> --baseline-style balanced --simulations 64 --max-depth 16 --max-transitions 10000 --neural-device cpu, one CPU core each (play.sh); network-138 played from generation 119 exported from 3-four-games's pause checkpoint at 05:39 on 27 November; network-55, the untrained network and the scripted balanced policy come from evaluations-2026-11-26/reports/ under the same rules, scenario, actions and network input

wealth_at_game_end.source: each game's wealth_components_at_stop; the alliance named first is the one played, the other two by the scripted balanced policy; the land-weighted run's network from the evidence file of the record of its 595th network update

land_zones_by_nation.source: at the start: china_minor_setup.json's territories and the Axis's starting wealth; at the end: each game's territorial_control, means over the 24 games

method:
The record of the second evaluation of the training run at 256x16 against the scripted balanced policy, after its
138th network update, 27 November 2026. Reads the reports of this folder (network-138, the third part's generation
119, exported from its pause checkpoint), beside the 26 November reports of the network after 55 network updates,
the untrained network and the scripted balanced policy (evaluations-2026-11-26/reports/), the evidence file of the
land-weighted run's 595th network update, and the manifests and serving logs of this run's second and third parts.
Writes docs/archive/records/training_256x16_update_138_2026_11_27.json and draws the record's figure in
docs/archive/records/figures/. Run from anywhere:
    python3 studies/campaign/runs/training-256x16-2026-11-25/evaluations-2026-11-27/make_record.py
